name: schedule_appointment
description: Schedule a medical appointment for a patient with a specific provider. Books a slot near the preferred date and returns confirmation with location, duration, and preparation instructions.

appointment_type.description: Type of appointment (One of: follow-up, annual-physical, urgent, specialist-referral, telehealth, lab-work, procedure)

preferred_date.description: Preferred appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: get_provider_availability
description: Check provider availability for scheduling within a date range. Returns open appointment slots grouped by date with slot type (in-person or telehealth).

date_range.description: Date range in 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD' format or number of days ahead (Default: 7)

name: get_upcoming_appointments
description: Get all upcoming scheduled appointments for a patient sorted by date, including provider, type, location, and reminder status.

name: send_appointment_reminder
description: Send a reminder notification for an upcoming appointment via the patient's preferred channel (SMS, email, or patient portal). Returns delivery confirmation.
